batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c DE Bollinger b DJ Bravo

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b SB Jakati

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c S Aravind b A Mithun

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c A Mithun b Z Khan

balls.text: back of a length, angling across him, Kohli heaves and misses. A rare blip on a very important innings
rare length ball from Bollinger, hit wide of long-on, Kohli comes back for two
slower ball, beats him, Kohli goes for the bye, and Dhoni goes for the unnecessary hit and concedes the overthrow. Very un-Dhoni like

Oh Tiwary's role seems to be to take out the Chennai bowlers! This is pulled, but late into the shot, and hit right back at Bollinger. Not as powerfully as the hit to Ashwin. Bollinger can't hold onto it. Very tough chance it was
low full toss outside off, drives square, but can't beat point
back of a length, no room, and Kohli does the next-best thing by placing it wide of deep square, and comes back for two
Morkel is playing with fire bowling length here. Tiwary gives this it his all, and is beaten by the low bounce
gets across this time and flicks this towards deep midwicket
Length ball again. Gentle pace again. Morkel cannot keep bowling this length at this pace. And Kohli handsomely goes inside-out over extra cover
Whoa. What a hit. Poor bowling I must say. Gentle pace. Length ball. Ripe for the taking. Over long-on
Kolhi completes a very important half-century with a lovely boundary. Makes room, lofts this late, over point. Kohli keeps improving every day
pulled down the ground, bad bounce for Bravo at long-on, and they are alert enough to come back for the second

oh he has nearly killed Ashwin. He doesn't seem to know where he is. Nasty nasty hit. All Tiwary's muscle into this shot back at Ashwin, who doesn't have time to get out of the way and is hit straight on the head. It was hit so hard the ricochet flew to long-off, and they came back for two. He just didn't know for a moment where he was. Walks off the field. Gavaskar reckons they should have called for the stretcher
full and wide, and Tiwary biffs this over extra cover. Not the best-looking extra cover drive but it does the job
short and wide, cut away straight to deep point
comes down the track, gets too close to it, and hence plays it along the ground towards long-on
darted into the legs, pushed to long-on for one
full toss, hit powerfully back over Ashwin's head, who tries to stick his left hand out but doesn't make any connection
full, outside off, squeezed out for a single to extra cover
full toss on the pads, driven down to long-on
Timber! Pomersbach had the right idea. This was a length ball, he stood tall, and looked to bosh it over midwicket. However, he swung down the wrong line, and the off stump is out of the ground
driven past extra cover for one

nearly does it all by himself. Superb stuff from Doug. First of all a big short ball, no room at all, Luke gets a limp top edge, and Doug runs towards short cover, and makes a one-handed catch, but as he makes the fall, the ball bounces out on impact
walks at him, digs out a yorker, and Bollinger dives to his right to prevent the single
Kohli gets into the hitting party now. What a clean shot without any fuss. Length ball, on middle and leg, and he wristily drives it over cow corner
shimmies down the pitch and drives it to long-on
full, looks for the big drive, gets a thick inside edge for one
cut away from in front of leg, in front of square, can't get it past extra
flighted delivery, pushed to long-off, hands it over to Kohli who should know Ashwin better
flat, around off, defended back
appeal for leg-before but Pomersbach has shuffled across enough to get outside the line of off. Gets a leg-bye to keep the strike
beautiful shot, on the up, inside out, past extra cover, along the ground
Fat flat six, one of the flattest you'll see. Pulled away from rib high, and goes over midwicket, into the boundary boards
Dropped? Not really, Dhoni is standing up, and this is a healthy enough edge for Pomersbach. Streaky but four
Muscle! Charges at Bravo and murders this short ball wide of long-on, who didn't have too much to move but couldn't. This went just too fast
beats him on the cut, angling this across him
lovely shot again, inside-out chip over extra cover, they come back for two
looked to come down the track, stays back to a flat delivery, pushes it down to long-off
straighter one outside off, beats the outside edge
Top shot, coming down the track, lofting this over long-off. Almost inside-out
just short of driving length, punched wide of sweeper-cover for two
floated outside off, and left alone
flat into the pads, placed wide of deep midwicket for two
dives to his right, past Luke to save this single
straighter one, just short of a length, hit back to Raina
forced past the straight midwicket for a single
looks for the cut, gets a single to short third
Lovely shot, just a touch short, and he rocks back and punches this wide of deep point
full, middle and leg, driven to long-off for one
Jakati strikes back. de Villiers charges at him, looking to go over long-on, but gets a bit too close to it and doesn't get the elevation to clear long-on. Vijay completes the simple catch
makes a diving save himself as this is pushed to his left
reverse-sweep from outside leg, wide of deep point, comes back for two
slightly short, not a long hop really, but de Villiers is lightning quick in rocking back and pulling it over midwicket
on the pads, worked around the corner
short, quicker one, 135ks, no room at all, played back to the bowler
slower ball, de Villiers goes back and punches this, but can't beat mid-off
hit just wide of midwicket for one
looks to cut, the ball doesn't quite come on, ends up hitting it in front of square, towards Raina at extra cover
steps forward, drops this short delivery into the covers and takes the single
pushed past the diving Morkel for one
forced down the ground for another single
clipped away to leg for one
looks to drop and run, Kohli refuses the single as it hasn't gone far off Dhoni
fuller this time, and pushed down the ground for one
short ball on the pads, goes deep into the crease to make it even shorter and pulls this between fine leg and deep square
cut away to get off the mark first ball
Bravo's slower ball strikes. Agarwal, more a drive man, sees a fullish delivery and goes for it, gets only the toe end, and holes out to long-on
punched through the covers for one
slower ball, short outside off, pushed wide of cover for one
wide down the leg side, third one for Bravo
cut away, there wasn't much room actually but he did well, but couldn't beat point
holds its line outside off, Kohli gets a single wide of cover
slower ball, bowled from behind the crease, pulled away to deep backward square
lovely pull shot, goes deep into the crease to manufacture this length, and pulls it between long-on and deep midwicket. All along the ground
cut away in front of square, wide of sweeper-cover, they come back for two
comes down the track, gets another skiddy delivery that doesn't turn. They'll get a leg-bye
another skiddy delivery, off and middle line, played back to the bowler
fuller, into the pads, worked away for one
sets himself up for a horizontal shot, but the ball doesn't turn and has to quickly adjust and punch this to sweeper-cover
another length delivery on the pads, mis-hit in the air, but it falls just short of deep midwicket
full on the pads, helped away wide of deep midwicket for a couple
length ball, holds its line outside off, beats Agarwal's hanging bat
slower ball, clipped away to deep midwicket for one
too short and too wide
short and wide again, opens the face to get a single to third man
short and wide, goes for the big cut, misses. Called a wide
tucks him up with a short delivery into the ribs
and Agarwal picks the carrom ball early, plays for the legspin and opens the face to guide it into the covers
full, near yorker length, dug out back to him
goes deep to pull this down to long-on for one
straight delivery again, can't get it past square leg
pushed towards cover. Straight delivery
full on the pads, worked away for a single
flat delivery outside leg
slower ball but Agarwal goes ahead with his drive, and puts enough behind this to clear mid-off. He has kept the momentum up for Bangalore despite Gayle's loss
looks for the third man area, but is cramped up by the line around off
opens him up like a can of beans, back of a length, slight seam movement away, and beats Agarwal's attempt to run this down
risky shot, punched away through the cover ring, and in the air too. It didn't go over anybody's head, just found the gap between cover-point and cover
bouncer, 136ks, good typical Mumbai bounce, Dhoni collects it in front of his face
angled a cross Agarwal, slight seam movement away too, and beats Agarwal's drive
fast delivery, surprises him a touch, but it is down the leg side too
full and flat, pushed to cover
defended into the leg side
angled across him, played to cover

and Ashwin strikes immediately after getting hit for a six again! And this is not the first time it has happened. I am not too sure about the decision, though. This was on offbreak that pitched short of a driving length and beat Gayle's sweep. Live time, I thought there was too much bounce and turn to be sure. Simon Taufel disagreed, and raised the finger. And as it so often happens, Simon Taufel is correct. Replays show it pitched in line with leg stump, turned a little, and skidded as opposed to bouncing too much. Would have hit the leg stump
slightly too short, not too short mind you, but Gayle rocks back and pulls this over cow corner. No respect tonight
dangerously non-turning and accurate delivery. Gayle gets the bat down in time
nice late-cut, slightly square of third man, comes back for a two even as Jakati makes a diving save at the boundary
nice check-drive from off-side line, but finds cover
short, into the ribs, keeps the pull down, gets the single
pulls the length back this time, tucked away off the hips for a single
clever stuff from Agarwal, backs away early, makes Morkel follow him, gets inside the line and flicks this fine of short fine leg
Agarwal had some trouble with Bollinger's pace, but finds Morkel's just fine. It's a length ball, and he has lofted it straight over Morkel's head
Gayle backs away again, Bollinger follows him with a short ball again, Gayle pulls out of the shot. Good stuff
more fun as Gayle backs away to send this to the Arabian Sea, but doesn't quite connect and hits it towards mid-on

Nasty nasty bouncer, kicking off just short of a length, and Gayle is late ducking into it. Flies off the shoulder for four leg-byes. Bollinger stares at Gayle, and then has a quiet word. These two seem to be good friends
cut away to third man for one, more of a steer than a forceful shot
looks for the upper cut, but Bollinger's bouncer is a bit too quick for him
back of a length, around off, punched to point
back of a length, outside off, guided to third man for one
charges at Morkel, gets too close to the delivery, and gets a single off the inside half of the bat. The long-on is deep
yorker, or nearly there, just outside off, played back to Albie
aha, a big swing from Agarwal, gets a thick inside edge onto the pads. They take the single. On strike comes Gayle
just outside off this time, and near yorker length, dug out square
juicy gift first up, leg-side length ball with fine leg pretty square. Agarwal says, "Thank you very much," and clips this fine for four

Morkel has finished it off! Raina needn't run any more. Similar ploy, makes room, Vettori follows hi, but misses the length, and he has slogged it over midwicket for six. Kohli stands stunned at the fence. Raina is elated and congratulates Morkel. Ashwin comes onto the field too, with his bandaged head. Bollinger breaks into a dance
Drama. Gets the yorker right, and they shout for two right for the word go. He loses his bat while turning, and even without the bat Morkel makes a swimming-pool dive to make the second
Morkel makes room, Vettori follows him, but Morkel gets it wide enough of long-on for a crucial four. Nothing wrong with the ball, missed the yorker by inches
yorker-length, flicked away into the leg side, brings Morkel on strike
full toss, hit down to long-on for one, sets up the last over beautifully
Low full toss,, crunched away over midwicket. Chennai have their noses ahead now. Rains is playing a beauty here. He has hurt every loose delivery here
Kolhi has saved runs again. Length ball, muscled down the ground, and Kolhi makes the diving save at long-on. Doesn't even concede the second
Morkel is paying back in kind here. Low full toss, smacked over long-off. Chennai are not going away that easily
slower ball, pitched on a length, and Morkel picks it early, and lofts it over long-on. This is what Kohli did to Morkel in the 19th over. Will he get his own back?
starts off with a wide yorker, just the single to sweeper-cover
low full toss, just the single to deep midwicket
misses his line, big wide down the leg side, de Villiers does well with the collection
comes forward to take this on the full, but gets just the single to long-on
that's a toe-chasing yorker, 102ks from two steps. Dot ball
in the block hole again, just the single
low full toss, hit back to Gayle. All Criss with Chris
full, on off, pushed for one. Raina on strike now

Full toss, and Raina is turning it on here. Lofted way into the stands behind the midwicket boundary. Chennai are still alive. They refuse to go away. They are the Australia of IPL. They make you beat them to pulp. They never contribute to their defeats
yorker, can't do any better with it than get the single to third man

He has found long-on! Bangalore pull Chennai back once again. Low full toss, Dhoni tries the helicopter shot again, slightly late into the shot, and it goes off the bottom part of the bat straight to long-on. Mithun is safe there
Air time! Unfurl the helicopter wrists! Full ball from Zak, and he has murdered this flat over midwicket. This game is on
near yorker outside off, squeezed for one to point
Not a great start for Zaheer. Length ball, and Raina plays the pick-up shot over midwicket. Another six for Raina, and another fifty. It has been hard work, but he hasn't thrown it away
the rare loose ball from Gayle, and Dhoni pulls this short one to the deep midwicket fence. Just staying alive here, are Chennai
another low full toss, just the single to long-on
wide yorker, dug out to extra cover for another single. Not good enough for CSK
slower through the air, driven to sweeper-cover for one
low full toss, hit straight to straight extra cover. Top stuff
Kohli has just come out of that collision and attacked this ball at long-on to keep these two sharp runners down to one

Jeez this is not a good day for player safety. Pomersbach's face - as he slides at the square-leg boundary - collides smack into Kohli's knee as the two are converging to field this. Another nasty blow. And Kolhi goes high in the air too, but lands safely. Gillespie-Waugh anybody?
pushed down the ground for another single
good comeback by Dhoni, this seems like a regulation drive to long-off for one, but this flies across the outfield, wide of long-off for four
arm ball, beautifully bowled, Dhoni plays for the turn, gets the inside edge on the pad
short and flat, pulled away, on the bounce to deep midwicket
flighted, middle and off, pushed down the ground for one
Malinga-style yorker again. Right on the crease. Another dot, and Gayle has pulled Chennai back again
floater outside off, cut away for another single
full and fast, driven to long-off for one
length ball, driven straight back to Gayle. Back to more than two a ball now
cut away nut straight to sweeper-cover this time
shortish outside off, hit wide of sweeper-cover, and they rush back for two
back of a length, worked away to deep midwicket for one
full ball, helicoptered away wide of long-on for four. Didn't go too wide of long-on, but he had absolutely no chance of fielding this
back of a length, tucked away square on the on side, but Mithun has overstepped! That's a big no-ball
That's a Raina special! Length ball, width too, but Raina has played a special shot. Down on a knee, he goes inside-out over extra cover
short again, but nicely played by Raina. On the hop, with an open face, past point
Mithun goes short, but down the leg side
Aha! Raina clears the front leg, and heaves a length ball over long-off. Not the prettiest of shots but effective nonetheless
angled across Dhoni, hit down to long-off for one
low full toss, hit straight to extra cover. Top over, just the one run from it
and bowls a yorker Malinga would be proud of. Raina can't do anything with this
closer to the stumps, pulled down the ground for one
another floater outside off, and Dhoni is reaching again as there is no turn on this
extra bounce this time as Dhoni looks to cut. beaten. Asking rate higher than two a ball now
floater outside off, no turn, and Dhoni pushes inside the line
... and strikes immediately. Badri tries to go inside-out, with the angle, and ends up slicing it to sweeper-cover. Aravind takes a good catch running in
Badri manufactures the desperately needed boundary. Comes down the track, and swats this between mid-on and midwicket
a failed attempt at a slog, gets a single off the inside half of the bat
another heave, but Mithun is staying short enough to not allow that shot. Mis-hit for one
back of a length, chipped to sweeper-cover for one
heaved away towards deep midwicket for one
slog-sweep, this was coming as Raina has been tied down and has been itching to hit. This was quick but in his swinging arc, and he gave it his all, clearing wide long-on with ease
makes room and drives this to long-off, along the ground
flat, short of driving length, pushed to long-off
full, and hit back powerfully at Vettori, who fumbles but doesn't allow the single
slower through the air, Badri comes down the track and drives it to long-on
clipped away off the pads to long leg

one more full toss, and Badri accepts it with glee driving it inside-out for four. Badri reaches the run-a-ball strike-rate now. Collides with Kohli, apologises immediately. Good spirit between these youngsters who at times compete for the same slot in the Indian team
oh another full toss, and Kohli is undoing the good work he did in the last over. Nicely clipped away by Badri for four past square leg
back of a  length, slogged to deep midwicket for one
another full toss, Badri makes room, gets an inside edge, hitting de Villiers on the gloves. To call it a drop will be unfair
length ball, hit to deep midwicket for one
full toss, taken at short fine leg, but it is too high a full toss. Taufel has no second thoughts about this. Just above waist height. Warned for the beamer
loose ball, angled down the leg side with the fine leg up, helped past the lone fielder by Raina
makes room, drives this square, past pint, comes back for two
flighted this time, fuller too, worked away into the on side
flat again, no room, hit straight to extra cover again
flat, angled across the left-hander, hit straight to extra cover
Vettori comes back with an arm ball, hit down to long-on for one
and is welcomed by a lovely inside-out chip over extra cover. Precise feet movement to make just enough room
driven down to long-off for a single. Good over
not a good day for the bowlers, this is hit back at Kohli, and he is late into attempting the catch. Hits his hands and pops out. No injury or damage done
driven down to long-on for one
makes room and drives square, for a single to deep point
driven, but straight to extra cover
full outside off, Badri tries the paddle, hit on the pad
Looking London, hitting Tokyo here. Another of the wild slogs, the head falls towards fine leg, the ball limps back to the bowler
more desperation here, Raina goes for the good old-fashioned agricultural slog. Can't beat midwicket
shuffles across to get inside the line of this, but nearly flicks it straight to square leg. Bounces just in front
stays accurate and short of a length, defended again
back of a length, Raina stays back, defends
steered to third man for one
Zaheer pulls the length back, but Raina slogs anyway, and off the inside half of the bat it goes for four to midwicket. It's not all rummy for Raina, though, as he seems to have cramped up badly
and Raina has had enough of trying to pierce the field. Clears the front leg, and lofts this full delivery over mid-off
Raina can't get rid of Agarwal! Hit straight to him this time. Last three shots have been hit towards extra, but not past him
Agarwal has saved four runs here! This was driven beautifully wide of extra cover, but Agarwal goes flying across and doesn't let it through
punched away nicely, but can't beat extra cover
length ball, shaping in, defended to midwicket
cramped for room again as Badri looks to late-cut it
looks for the drive outside off, gets an inside edge onto the pad
angled a cross him, pushed to cover
pulled wide of deep midwicket for a couple
pushed to cover
shuffles dangerously across, but gets the bat down in time for a single
pushed to mid-off, and Raina turns down the single. So just the one wide from this over
good pace again, hits him hard in the thigh pad
Desperation. Badri backs away to play this shortish delivery. makes no contact, but it was very close to taking the edge
heavy ball, Badri late into the drive, the inside edge hits him on the pad
no room as Badri looks to run this down to third man
length ball, close to off, pushed to cover
wide down the leg side
slightly fuller, opens the face towards point, and Raina has to make a desperate dive to complete the single
late-cut, Badri off and running, past point
back of a length, defended to cover

This, though, is bad news for CSK. Both openers gone. Aravind gets close to the stumps, and full, and Vijay plays across the line, misses it, and is hit in front of the stumps. Easy call for Taufel. Even though the ball didn't swing, Aravind did himself a huge favour by getting close to the stumps, eliminating the angle. Oh oh. Hang on. The replays surprise me again. The ball pitched just outside leg. He was unfortunate in that the ball pitched outside leg, but he wanted the leg-bye to slip, and Gayle had run him out anyway
angled a cross, driven to extra cover, doesn't find the gap
golf swing. Vijay just plonks he front foot and lofts this length ball over mid-on. Confident shot
Zak strikes! This seams in, big movement, pitches back of a length, outside off, catches Hussey on the crease, plumb in front. Rauf has no second thoughts about this. RCB are pumped
opens the face on this, still can't beat point
back of a length, around off, pushed to point
fuller, straighter, pushed wide of mid-on
angled across Vijay, left alone
this one jags back in and Hussey has shouldered arms! de Villiers has to dive to save four byes
swing away from Hussey, starts just outside off, moves away, called wide. A touch harsh as this swung after passing the batsman
